disclaimer: An activity space for looking at familiar places, objects, photographs and sounds together. It is not a medical treatment.

who.title: Who is this session for?
who.savedHint: Uses the photographs, sounds and words a caregiver saved on this device.
who.demoHint: Demo content only. No personal information.
who.none: No personal profile is saved on this device yet. A caregiver can make one in Caregiver setup.

language.title: Language
language.machine: This translation was machine-generated and has not yet been reviewed by a fluent speaker.

comfort.title: Comfort settings
comfort.hint: Text size, contrast, motion, sound and subtitles.

caregiver.title: Caregiver area
caregiver.hint: Add photographs, sounds and your own prompts, and choose topics to leave out.
caregiver.failed: Caregiver setup could not open just now.
caregiver.homeHint: Portraits, layout and questions for the 3D house used by the guided tasks.

camera.title: Camera support (optional)
camera.hint: It can wait to speak a new prompt, or offer the same prompt once more. Everything works without it.

guided.title: Guided tasks — tasks with answers set by a caregiver
guided.hint: The house tasks, where a caregiver set the answers. They are separate from the open-ended activities above.

place.title: Choose a place
place.intro: Pick a place to explore. You can change it later.
place.failed: The places could not be loaded just now.

regional.title: Optional regional packs
regional.intro: These packs focus on one region. They are never chosen automatically.

place.preview: Preview: this pack is not complete yet.
place.unavailable: Some content could not be loaded and is not offered: {names}. Details are in the browser console.

activity.title: Choose an activity
activity.note: No scores, no timers, no right or wrong answers.
activity.failed: This room could not be prepared just now.
activity.guidedFirst: The caregiver's sequence is shown first.
activity.setupHint: A caregiver can add content for this in Caregiver setup.

explore.freeHint: Choose anything in the room to look at it more closely.
explore.gentleCue: Take your time. Here it is again, whenever you are ready.
explore.synthesized: This sound was made with a sound synthesiser, not recorded.
explore.subtitlesOff: Prompt text is hidden because subtitles are off.
explore.lookHint: Seated mode: click an object in the scene or its name below to move the view there. Drag to look around.
explore.walkHint: Walk mode: use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move; drag to look. Photo scenes keep you near the capture point. On a touch screen, press and hold the arrows.

chat.title: Talk about this picture
chat.hint: The selected picture and question go to the model chosen in setup. Voice input is transcribed by your browser; you can type instead.
chat.placeholder: What do you think of this picture?
chat.noMic: Voice input is unavailable here. Type your question instead.
chat.micError: Microphone input did not start. Check browser microphone permission or type your question.
chat.selectPicture: Select a picture in the room before asking about it.
chat.failed: I could not answer just now. Please try again.

caregiver.title: Caregiver panel
caregiver.tip: Follow their lead. Silence is fine, and there is no need to hurry.
caregiver.notePlaceholder: What was shared, in your own words

pause.title: Paused
pause.body: Take your time. Everything will be here when you come back.

exit.title: Would you like to end this activity?
exit.body: You will see a short record of what was looked at.

closeup.title: Close-up
closeup.demoNotice: Demo picture: an illustration, not a real memory

summary.title: Session summary
summary.intro: A factual record of this session. There are no scores.
summary.endedFinished: The activity went through every item.
summary.endedExited: The activity was ended before the last item.

vision.title: Camera support (kept separate)
vision.label: These numbers describe how the camera's tracking worked during the session, not the person. They are heuristic and are not a clinical measure.
vision.held: Times a new prompt's speech was held

summary.exportNote: Observable activity only. Not a clinical measure, and not a record of anyone's memory.

settings.title: Comfort settings
settings.seatedHint: The view stays in one comfortable place and moves gently to what you choose.
settings.walkHint: Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys; drag to look. In photographed places, movement stays near the capture point.
settings.speech: Read prompts aloud when there is no recording
settings.speechMissing: This device has no voice installed for this language, so prompts are shown as text.
settings.caregiverAssistHint: A saved profile's own choice applies at the start of each activity.
settings.notSaved: These settings could not be saved on this device. They apply until the page is closed.
